{3.3} • The locks are changed because the tenant has been evicted by the Sheriff, or

{3.5} It is an offence for a landlord to illegally lock a tenant out of their rental unit or the building. {3.6} If a landlord is convicted in Provincial Court under the Provincial Offences Act , they could be fined up to $100,000 if the landlord is an individual, or $500,000, if the landlord is a corporation.
